cognitive_evolution.previous_paradigm: Title filter used re.search(rf'\b{re.escape(neg_clean)}\b', title_lower) for ALL negative keywords including multi-word phrases like 'Chartered Accountant'.
cognitive_evolution.new_paradigm: Multi-word negative keywords (containing a space) must use plain substring match (neg_clean in title_lower) instead of word-boundary regex. \b anchors fail for phrases. Single-word keywords still use \b for precision.
cognitive_evolution.reason_for_shift: Root cause: re.search(rf'\bchartered accountant\b'...) - trailing \b after a space is invalid. Python silently runs but boundary matching is unreliable for multi-word phrases.

long_term_application: In ALL filter functions that iterate negative_keywords: bifurcate by ' ' in neg_clean - use 'in' substring check for phrases, \b...\b regex only for single tokens. Apply to both 04_job_discovery.py::is_title_allowed() AND ai_client.py::arbitrate_card_fit().
